Click'n'Load from filecrypt reaches KnightLoader through the browser extension.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Click'n'Load from filecrypt reaches KnightLoader.** filecrypt sends its links from a small helper window of its own, which has no toolbar. The extension caught the links but could not open its popup there, so they waited behind a yellow "…" on the toolbar icon while the helper closed itself. The popup now opens in the browser window that shows the site, in Firefox and in Chrome alike.
